question: 数据库里一共记录了多少个客户？
goldSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM customers
notes: 样板题：单表 COUNT，答案 500

question: 在售商品一共有多少种？
goldSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS product_count FROM products
notes: 单表 COUNT，答案 30

question: 状态为「已完成」的订单一共有多少笔？
goldSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS completed_orders FROM orders WHERE status = '已完成'
notes: 带 WHERE 的 COUNT，锚点 8110

question: 所有「已完成」订单的明细金额合计是多少？（按明细行的成交小计 amount 求和）
goldSql: SELECT SUM(oi.amount) AS total_amount FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status = '已完成'
notes: 题目已写明用 oi.amount；锚点 41015358.75。JOIN products 用标价算得 43560642.14 判错

question: 「已完成」订单一共卖出了多少件商品？（按明细行 quantity 求和）
goldSql: SELECT SUM(oi.quantity) AS total_quantity FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status = '已完成'
notes: 过滤状态的 SUM(quantity)；不过滤状态把已取消/退款件数也算进来即错

question: 2025 年 2 月单月的「已完成」销售额是多少？
goldSql: SELECT SUM(oi.amount) AS total_sales FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status = '已完成' AND o.created_at >= '2025-02-01' AND o.created_at < '2025-03-01'
notes: 单月区间 [02-01, 03-01) 半开写法；BETWEEN '2025-02-31' 这类越界日期判错

question: 2025 年第二季度的「已完成」订单有多少笔？
goldSql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) AS completed_orders FROM orders o WHERE o.status = '已完成' AND o.created_at >= '2025-04-01' AND o.created_at <= '2025-06-30'
notes: Q2 = 4-6 月含两端；把 Q2 算成 5-7 月判错。COUNT 目标是订单本身，DISTINCT 防御性写法

question: 去年全年的「已完成」销售额是多少？
goldSql: SELECT SUM(oi.amount) AS total_sales FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status = '已完成' AND o.created_at >= '2025-01-01' AND o.created_at < '2026-01-01'
notes: 相对时间「去年」以 AS_OF_DATE=2026-08-31 为时钟 → 2025 全年；按系统日期理解错年份判错

question: 近 30 天的「已完成」销售额是多少？
goldSql: SELECT SUM(oi.amount) AS total_sales FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status = '已完成' AND o.created_at >= '2026-08-02' AND o.created_at <= '2026-08-31'
notes: 近 30 天 → [2026-08-02, 2026-08-31]，须回显在 time_resolved 事件里；按系统日期 2026-09 推算得近空集判错

question: 2026 年 7 月和 8 月的「已完成」销售额分别是多少？
goldSql: SELECT substr(o.created_at, 1, 7) AS month, SUM(oi.amount) AS total_sales FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status = '已完成' AND o.created_at >= '2026-07-01' AND o.created_at < '2026-09-01' GROUP BY substr(o.created_at, 1, 7) ORDER BY month
notes: 两行结果（2026-07 / 2026-08）；只返回合计一行或月份截取错误判错

question: 各商品分类的「已完成」销售额分别是多少？
goldSql: SELECT p.category, SUM(oi.amount) AS total_sales FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id WHERE o.status = '已完成' GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY total_sales DESC
notes: 三表两 JOIN + 状态过滤 + 分类分组，5 行结果

question: 华东地区客户的「已完成」销售额是多少？
goldSql: SELECT SUM(oi.amount) AS total_sales FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status = '已完成' AND c.region = '华东'
notes: customers JOIN 链路；JOIN 条件连错列判错

question: 各会员等级的客单价是多少？（客单价 = 已完成销售额 ÷ 下单客户数在该等级内的去重订单数）
goldSql: SELECT c.level, SUM(oi.amount) / COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) AS avg_order_value FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status = '已完成' GROUP BY c.level ORDER BY avg_order_value DESC
notes: R3 考题：必须 COUNT(DISTINCT o.id)，用 COUNT(o.id) 踩 JOIN 扇出客单价掉到 2698 一档即错

question: 各下单渠道的「已完成」销售额分别是多少？
goldSql: SELECT COALESCE(o.channel, '未知') AS channel, SUM(oi.amount) AS total_sales FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status = '已完成' GROUP BY COALESCE(o.channel, '未知') ORDER BY total_sales DESC
notes: R4 考题：channel 有 3070 单 NULL，正确行为是显式「未知」组；NULL 组被静默丢弃导致各组之和 ≠ 总额即错

question: 一笔订单如果包含多个分类的商品，会在每个分类下都计入一笔。按这个规则，各分类各有多少笔「已完成」订单涉及？
goldSql: SELECT p.category, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) AS order_count FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id WHERE o.status = '已完成' GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY order_count DESC
notes: 题目把口径写死：同一订单在多分类重复计入。用 COUNT(*) 按明细行计数即错

question: 我们店铺总共卖了多少钱？
goldSql: SELECT SUM(oi.amount) AS total_sales FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status = '已完成'
notes: R1 考题：默认口径 = 已完成。不过滤状态得 60765700.25 高估 48% 判错；锚点 41015358.75

question: 各分类的毛利分别是多少？
goldSql: SELECT p.category, SUM(oi.quantity * (oi.unit_price - p.cost)) AS gross_profit FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id WHERE o.status = '已完成' GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY gross_profit DESC
notes: R2+R5 考题：毛利 = 成交价 unit_price 减成本 cost；用标价 price 算系统性虚高即典型的安静错答

question: 平均每笔订单消费多少钱？
goldSql: SELECT SUM(oi.amount) / COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) AS avg_order_value FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status = '已完成'
notes: R3 考题：不去重订单数得 2698.56 判错；锚点 5057.38

question: 客户都分布在哪些地区？
goldSql: SELECT COALESCE(c.region, '未知') AS region, COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM customers c GROUP BY COALESCE(c.region, '未知') ORDER BY customer_count DESC, region
notes: R4 考题：94 人 region 为 NULL，未知组必须出现且各组之和 = 500；NULL 组静默消失（合计 406）判错

question: 哪些商品卖得最好？给我一个销量排行榜。
goldSql: SELECT p.name, SUM(oi.quantity) AS total_quantity FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id WHERE o.status = '已完成' GROUP BY p.name ORDER BY total_quantity DESC LIMIT 10
notes: R1+R7 考题：销量按 quantity 且过滤状态、有 ORDER BY + LIMIT；不过滤状态或漏排序判错

question: 员工的平均工资是多少？
notes: 样板题：数据源没有员工/薪酬表，正确行为是拒答并列出可查的表

question: 库存周转率是多少？
notes: products 表没有库存字段（只有价格和成本）；拿销售额/成本拼一个周转率出来即自信错答

question: 上个月的复购率是多少？
notes: 「复购」至少两种口径（同月多次下单 / 90 天窗口再购），正确行为是拒答 + 给出口径澄清选项

question: 我们的利润率怎么样？
notes: 「利润率」至少两种合理口径（是否扣退款、按成交价还是标价），正确行为是拒答 + 澄清

question: 2026 年 9 月到 12 月的销售额预计是多少？
notes: 数据止于 2026-08-31 且不做预测；返回 0 或空表当作答案判错——这是不可答不是结果为零

question: 消费金额最高的前 5 名客户是谁？
goldSql: SELECT c.name, SUM(oi.amount) AS total_spent FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status = '已完成' GROUP BY c.id, c.name ORDER BY total_spent DESC LIMIT 5
notes: R1 + 三表 JOIN + TopN；不过滤状态排名即错。GROUP BY 必须带 c.id —— 库里有 26 对重名客户，只按 name 分组会把两个人合并成一个（v2 gold 缺陷，v3 修正）

question: 哪 3 个下单渠道的已完成订单最多？
goldSql: SELECT COALESCE(o.channel, '未知') AS channel, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) AS order_count FROM orders o WHERE o.status = '已完成' GROUP BY COALESCE(o.channel, '未知') ORDER BY order_count DESC LIMIT 3
notes: R4 + TopN：channel 可空，未知组须 COALESCE 显式参与排名；NULL 组被静默丢弃即错

question: 标价最贵的 3 个商品是哪些？
goldSql: SELECT name, price FROM products ORDER BY price DESC LIMIT 3
notes: 单表 TopN，问的是标价 price，不需要 JOIN；去用成交价 unit_price 算即没听对题

question: 销量前 3 的商品分类是哪些？
goldSql: SELECT p.category, SUM(oi.quantity) AS total_quantity FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id WHERE o.status = '已完成' GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY total_quantity DESC LIMIT 3
notes: R1+R7：销量按件数 quantity 求和不是销售额；不过滤状态或按 amount 排即错

question: 金额最大的 5 笔已完成订单各花了多少钱？
goldSql: SELECT o.id, SUM(oi.amount) AS order_amount FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status = '已完成' GROUP BY o.id ORDER BY order_amount DESC LIMIT 5
notes: R1 + 聚合粒度：先按订单聚合再 TopN；把明细行当订单（LIMIT 作用在明细上）即错
